newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moonstone in Australia project deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moonstone in Australia project deal.

text.p: Moonstone Diamond Corp NL said on Thursday that it had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Vageta Pty Ltd under which Vageta has an option to acquire a portfolio of Moonstone's Australian projects.

Should Vageta exercise its option, Moonstone will receive vendor shares in a company seeking quotation of the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) over the next six months, to the value of A$200,000 Moonstone said.
Moonstone said the projects that Vageta had an option to acquire were Cameron's Bore, Argyle Dykes and Napier West, all in Western Australia.

The deal is based on the new company being admitted to the official list of the ASX within six months of signing the MOU and that Vageta must maintain the tenements in good standing prior to the new company listing on the ASX.
